editor_anchors.name: Thelma Schoonmaker
editor_anchors.signature: effortless momentum, music-like phrasing, emotional energy

editor_anchors.name: Walter Murch
editor_anchors.signature: Rule of Six, subtractive editing, sound and picture as one

editor_anchors.name: Michael Kahn
editor_anchors.signature: stillness as deliberate as action, continuity perfection

pacing_signatures.name: Slow Build Setup
pacing_signatures.prompt: PACING DNA [pacing_slow_build_setup]: Edit and pace like slow-build setup — unhurried entry, intentional stillness before speech, Murch Rule-of-Six emotion-first rhythm, natural breath before first word, optimized for seamless stitch from prior block.

pacing_signatures.name: Mid-Tempo Dialogue
pacing_signatures.prompt: PACING DNA [pacing_mid_tempo_dialogue]: Schoonmaker effortless mid-tempo momentum; natural conversational pauses between phrases; dialogue tone evolves organically; match-action clean on stitch; subtle sound bridges if flow improves.

pacing_signatures.name: Schoonmaker Momentum
pacing_signatures.prompt: PACING DNA [pacing_schoonmaker_momentum]: Thelma Schoonmaker effortless momentum — energy and emotion drive cut rhythm; music-like phrasing; no rush, no drag; 15s block feels like one breathed take.

pacing_signatures.name: Murch Subtractive
pacing_signatures.prompt: PACING DNA [pacing_murch_subtractive]: Walter Murch subtractive rhythm — emotion over story over rhythm; remove dead air; near-silence as power; sound and picture cut as one organism; intentional pauses that reveal inner state.

pacing_signatures.name: Fincher Tension Acceleration
pacing_signatures.prompt: PACING DNA [pacing_fincher_tension_accel]: Fincher clinical rhythm acceleration — precise foley sync, vertical-cut energy, tension builds block-over-block without melodrama; ambient may drop subtractively at beat peaks.

pacing_signatures.name: Lubezki Long-Take Flow
pacing_signatures.prompt: PACING DNA [pacing_lubezki_long_take_flow]: Unbroken experiential flow within 15s — camera and sound feel like one long take; organic handheld/Steadicam breathing; invisible stitch at block boundary via J-cut overlap.

pacing_signatures.name: Invisible J-Cut
pacing_signatures.prompt: PACING DNA [pacing_invisible_jcut]: Invisible editing — audio leads or trails picture at block edges; generate built-in J-cut or L-cut overlap; dialogue breath extends across stitch point; zero jump drift.

chain_pacing_prompt: Continue from attached final frame + previous audio tail. Pace and edit this next block with Schoonmaker effortless momentum and Murch subtractive rhythm. Dialogue has natural breathing pauses and tone evolution. Visual and audio stitch perfectly — no jump, no drift. Evolve toward next emotional beat while maintaining master aesthetic.

ffmpeg_polish.note: Run after manual stitch when rhythm gaps proven — light EQ ducking and crossfade audio polish
